{"tools":[
{"name":"search_customers","description":"Searches customer records by name, email, phone, city, or tag and returns a short list of matches. Use it when you don't have the customer ID yet.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"query":{"type":"string","description":"Free text matched against name, email and phone"},"city":{"type":"string"},"tag":{"type":"string","description":"Only customers carrying this tag"},"limit":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":100,"default":20}},"required":["query"]},"request":"Can you find the customer whose email is maria.kowalski@example.com?"},
{"name":"get_customer","description":"Returns the full CRM profile for one customer by ID. The profile includes contact details, tags, segment memberships, lifetime value, and marketing consent status.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"customer_id":{"type":"string"}},"required":["customer_id"]},"request":"Pull up the full profile for customer C-20418, I want to see her tags and consent status."},
{"name":"create_customer","description":"Creates a new customer record in the CRM, for example for a walk-in or phone customer. Fails if the email already exists.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"first_name":{"type":"string"},"last_name":{"type":"string"},"email":{"type":"string","format":"email"},"phone":{"type":"string"},"address":{"type":"object","properties":{"street":{"type":"string"},"city":{"type":"string"},"postal_code":{"type":"string"},"country":{"type":"string"}}},"marketing_consent":{"type":"boolean","default":false},"tags":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"}}},"required":["first_name","last_name","email"]},"request":"Add a new customer: Tom Becker, tom@beckerbikes.example, phone 030 5550142, he agreed to get our newsletter."},
{"name":"update_customer","description":"Updates contact details, tags, or marketing consent on an existing customer record. Only the supplied fields change.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"customer_id":{"type":"string"},"first_name":{"type":"string"},"last_name":{"type":"string"},"email":{"type":"string","format":"email"},"phone":{"type":"string"},"marketing_consent":{"type":"boolean"},"add_tags":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"}},"remove_tags":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"string"}}},"required":["customer_id"]},"request":"Customer C-11872 moved and has a new phone number, 0171 5558834. Please update it."},
{"name":"merge_duplicate_customers","description":"Merges two duplicate customer records into one. Notes, complaints, and segment memberships of the duplicate move to the surviving record, and the duplicate is then archived.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"primary_customer_id":{"type":"string","description":"Record that survives"},"duplicate_customer_id":{"type":"string","description":"Record to fold in and archive"}},"required":["primary_customer_id","duplicate_customer_id"]},"request":"C-5520 and C-7731 are the same person, Anna Weiss. Merge them and keep C-5520."},
{"name":"anonymize_customer","description":"Irreversibly erases personal data from a customer record to fulfil a GDPR erasure request. It keeps anonymized aggregate history, so it is not the same as deleting an order.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"customer_id":{"type":"string"},"request_reference":{"type":"string","description":"Ticket or reference of the erasure request"},"confirm":{"type":"boolean","description":"Must be true to proceed"}},"required":["customer_id","confirm"]},"request":"Mr. Hoffmann sent a formal data erasure request, ticket GDPR-2291. Please wipe his personal data from customer C-3045."},
{"name":"add_customer_note","description":"Adds an internal note to a customer's record, such as a call summary, a preference, or a warning for colleagues. Notes are never visible to the customer.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"customer_id":{"type":"string"},"text":{"type":"string"},"category":{"type":"string","enum":["call","preference","billing","warning","general"],"default":"general"},"pinned":{"type":"boolean","default":false}},"required":["customer_id","text"]},"request":"Make a note on C-9034 that she prefers delivery in the afternoon and always wants a call before the courier arrives."},
{"name":"list_customer_notes","description":"Lists the internal notes on a customer's record, newest first, with author and date. Use it to review the history before contacting the customer.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"customer_id":{"type":"string"},"category":{"type":"string","enum":["call","preference","billing","warning","general"]},"limit":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":200,"default":50}},"required":["customer_id"]},"request":"What notes did my team leave on customer C-6610 over the past months?"},
{"name":"log_complaint","description":"Records a new customer complaint in the CRM and links it to the customer. Use it when a customer reports a problem with a product, delivery, or service.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"customer_id":{"type":"string"},"subject":{"type":"string"},"description":{"type":"string"},"category":{"type":"string","enum":["product_quality","delivery","billing","service","other"]},"severity":{"type":"string","enum":["low","medium","high"],"default":"medium"},"related_order_number":{"type":"string"}},"required":["customer_id","subject","description","category"]},"request":"Log a high severity complaint for C-4412: the espresso machine she bought arrived with a cracked water tank, order 88213."},
{"name":"list_complaints","description":"Lists complaints filtered by status, category, severity, customer, or date range. Use it to see what is open or to review one customer's complaint history.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"customer_id":{"type":"string"},"status":{"type":"string","enum":["open","in_progress","resolved","closed"]},"category":{"type":"string","enum":["product_quality","delivery","billing","service","other"]},"severity":{"type":"string","enum":["low","medium","high"]},"created_after":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"created_before":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"limit":{"type":"integer","default":25}},"required":[]},"request":"Show me all open high-severity complaints about delivery."},
{"name":"update_complaint_status","description":"Changes the status of a complaint and optionally adds a resolution comment. Use it when work on a complaint starts, ends, or the case is closed.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"complaint_id":{"type":"string"},"status":{"type":"string","enum":["open","in_progress","resolved","closed"]},"resolution_comment":{"type":"string"}},"required":["complaint_id","status"]},"request":"Mark complaint CMP-1093 as resolved. We replaced the item and the customer is happy."},
{"name":"flag_complaint_refund_request","description":"Marks a complaint as needing a refund and records the proposed amount and reason for approval. It does not move any money. Payment processing happens elsewhere.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"complaint_id":{"type":"string"},"proposed_amount":{"type":"number","minimum":0},"currency":{"type":"string","default":"EUR"},"reason":{"type":"string"}},"required":["complaint_id","proposed_amount","reason"]},"request":"On complaint CMP-1107, note that we should refund 49.90 euros because the item was damaged, so the finance team can approve it."},
{"name":"get_complaint_report","description":"Generates an aggregated report of complaints for a period: counts by category and severity, average resolution time, and the top repeat complainants. Use it for reviews and trend analysis.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"start_date":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"end_date":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"group_by":{"type":"string","enum":["category","severity","week","month"],"default":"category"}},"required":["start_date","end_date"]},"request":"Give me a complaint report for last quarter, broken down by month, with average resolution times."},
{"name":"create_segment","description":"Creates a customer segment defined by rules such as total spend, last purchase date, city, or tag. The segment updates automatically as customers match or stop matching.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"name":{"type":"string"},"description":{"type":"string"},"match":{"type":"string","enum":["all","any"],"default":"all"},"rules":{"type":"array","items":{"type":"object","properties":{"field":{"type":"string","enum":["total_spent","order_count","last_purchase_date","city","tag","marketing_consent"]},"operator":{"type":"string","enum":["equals","not_equals","greater_than","less_than","before","after","contains"]},"value":{"type":["string","number","boolean"]}},"required":["field","operator","value"]}}},"required":["name","rules"]},"request":"Create a segment called 'Lapsed big spenders' for customers who spent over 500 euros in total but haven't bought anything since January 1st, 2024."},
{"name":"list_segments","description":"Lists all customer segments with their rules and current member counts.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"name_contains":{"type":"string"},"limit":{"type":"integer","default":50}},"required":[]},"request":"What customer segments do we have set up, and how many people are in each?"},
{"name":"get_segment_members","description":"Returns the customers currently in a segment, with basic contact details. Use it to inspect or export the audience.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"segment_id":{"type":"string"},"only_consented":{"type":"boolean","default":false,"description":"Return only customers who agreed to marketing"},"limit":{"type":"integer","minimum":1,"maximum":500,"default":100},"cursor":{"type":"string"}},"required":["segment_id"]},"request":"List the customers in the 'VIP 2024' segment who have opted in to marketing."},
{"name":"add_customer_to_segment","description":"Manually adds a customer to a static segment. It does not work on rule-based segments, which fill automatically.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"segment_id":{"type":"string"},"customer_id":{"type":"string"}},"required":["segment_id","customer_id"]},"request":"Put customer C-2287 into our 'Trade show contacts' segment."},
{"name":"send_customer_email","description":"Sends a one-to-one email to a single customer from the shop's address and records it in their history. Use it for personal replies, apologies, or follow-ups, not mass mailings.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"customer_id":{"type":"string"},"subject":{"type":"string"},"body":{"type":"string"},"reply_to":{"type":"string","format":"email"},"related_complaint_id":{"type":"string"}},"required":["customer_id","subject","body"]},"request":"Send an apology email to customer C-4412 about her cracked espresso machine tank and tell her a replacement is on its way."},
{"name":"send_segment_email","description":"Sends or schedules a marketing email to all consenting members of a segment. Customers without marketing consent are skipped automatically.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"segment_id":{"type":"string"},"subject":{"type":"string"},"body":{"type":"string"},"send_at":{"type":"string","format":"date-time","description":"Omit to send immediately"},"test_mode":{"type":"boolean","default":false,"description":"Send only to the sender address as a preview"}},"required":["segment_id","subject","body"]},"request":"Schedule our spring sale announcement to the 'Newsletter subscribers' segment for next Monday at 9am."},
{"name":"list_customer_emails","description":"Shows the history of emails sent to a customer by the CRM, with subject, date, and delivery status such as delivered, bounced, or opened.","input_schema":{"type":"object","properties":{"customer_id":{"type":"string"},"status":{"type":"string","enum":["queued","delivered","opened","bounced"]},"since":{"type":"string","format":"date"},"limit":{"type":"integer","default":25}},"required":["customer_id"]},"request":"Did the order apology email we sent to customer C-7001 last week actually get delivered?"}
]}
